desc:
🛴 Welcome to Scooters for Animals! 🐾

Ride, explore, and collect awesome animals!

⚡ Upgrade your scooter to go faster
🗺️ Travel through new areas and discover rare animals
🐾 Rescue and collect animals along the way
🥚 Find special eggs and hatch powerful pets
💰 Earn cash from your animals, even while offline
🔧 Upgrade your scooter, speed, and other gear
✨ Discover rare sizes, Mythics, and Exclusive animals
📖 Complete your Animal Index and collect them all

🏁 Upgrade your scooter, unlock every area, and build the ultimate animal collection!

👍 Like the game and join the group for rewards and future updates!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet
